message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_14141",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":748,"var":"entry","code":"rootDir()->addEntry(entry)","role":"source","note":"ZIP entry 'a/b' with uncompressed size 0 is parsed and added as a KZipFileEntry into directory 'a'. This zero-size file entry is the input-controlled state that triggers the bug."},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":753,"var":"tdir","code":"KArchiveDirectory *tdir = findOrCreate(path)","role":"intermediate","note":"When processing ZIP entry 'a/b/c/d', findOrCreate('a/b/c') is called. This is the outer findOrCreate call."},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":492,"var":"parent","code":"parent = findOrCreate(left)","role":"intermediate","note":"Outer findOrCreate('a/b/c') cannot find 'a/b/c', splits into left='a/b' and recursively calls findOrCreate('a/b')."},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":468,"var":"ent","code":"const KArchiveEntry *ent = rootDir()->entry(path)","role":"intermediate","note":"Inner findOrCreate('a/b') looks up path 'a/b' and finds the zero-size KZipFileEntry 'b' in directory 'a'."},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":482,"var":"myEntry","code":"rootDir()->removeEntry(myEntry)","role":"root_cause","note":"removeEntry is called on rootDir but 'b' lives in subdirectory 'a', not rootDir. The removal fails silently (logged: directory '/' has no entry with name 'b'). The entry is then deleted at line 483 while directory 'a' still holds the dangling pointer in its QHash."},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":497,"var":"e","code":"KArchiveDirectory *e = new KArchiveDirectory(this, dirname, ...)","role":"intermediate","note":"Inner findOrCreate creates a new KArchiveDirectory named 'b' to replace the deleted file entry."},
   {"step":7,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":839,"var":"entry","code":"delete entry","role":"intermediate","note":"addEntry on directory 'a' finds the dangling pointer for 'b' still in QHash, considers it a duplicate, and deletes the newly created directory. Inner findOrCreate returns the now-freed pointer."},
   {"step":8,"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":836,"var":"d->entries","code":"if (d->entries.value(entry->name()))","role":"sink","note":"Outer findOrCreate uses the freed pointer as parent and calls parent->addEntry(). Accessing d (the private data member) of the freed KArchiveDirectory triggers heap-use-after-free READ 8."}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":748,"operands":["entry","ucsize"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":482,"operands":["rootDir()","myEntry"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"myEntry->parent()","right":"rootDir()"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":836,"operands":["d->entries","entry->name()"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"d","right":"nullptr"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/kzip.cpp","function":"KZip::openArchive","line":748,"operands":["entry"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":468,"operands":["ent"]},
      "type":"data","via":["rootDir()->entry(path)"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchive::findOrCreate","line":482,"operands":["myEntry"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":839,"operands":["entry"]},
      "type":"data","via":["dangling pointer in d->entries QHash"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":839,"operands":["entry"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/karchive.cpp","function":"KArchiveDirectory::addEntry","line":836,"operands":["d->entries"]},
      "type":"data","via":["freed pointer returned from inner findOrCreate as parent"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
